proof_scope: A multi-file Python module (scenarios/variable_state/) has a shared-mutable-default state leak. These cases prove the debugger can set a breakpoint at the error, run to it, and surface the exact paused variable state that reveals the bug -- the machinery an agent uses to describe what is wrong -- and that an unreachable breakpoint is not accepted as proof.

claims.proves: the debugger stops at a chosen line across a multi-file module and captures the paused frame's variable state, which exposes a cross-call state leak (second==36, expected 30; seen already polluted when the second report begins)
claims.does_not_prove: VS Code bridge session control, stepping, or human interaction -- those are covered by the capability-gated matrix (#1441)

cases.name: breakpoint-reaches-bug-final-value
cases.description: Set a breakpoint in main where both report aggregates are bound, run to it, and read the frame: second is 36 where 30 was expected. This is the paused state an agent would describe.
command: set -euo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; D="$(mktemp -d)"; cp ../scenarios/variable_state/*.py "$D/"; export PYTHONPATH="$D"; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/capture_breakpoints.py --break "$D/main.py:21" --local first --local second --out "$D/proof.json" -- "$D/main.py"; python3 ../scenarios/variable_state/check.py "$D/proof.json" final

cases.name: breakpoint-exposes-cross-call-state-leak
cases.description: Set the breakpoint on the tally return line for the whole run and read seen at each hit. The second report's first call already carries the first report's values (seen==[1, 2, 3, 10]) -- the shared mutable default is directly visible in the paused frame.
command: set -euo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; D="$(mktemp -d)"; cp ../scenarios/variable_state/*.py "$D/"; export PYTHONPATH="$D"; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/capture_breakpoints.py --break "$D/tally.py:12" --local seen --local value --out "$D/proof.json" -- "$D/main.py"; python3 ../scenarios/variable_state/check.py "$D/proof.json" leak

cases.name: unreachable-breakpoint-is-not-proof
cases.description: A breakpoint on a line that never executes yields zero hits. The capturer must fail closed (exit non-zero) rather than emit a proof for a breakpoint that never fired -- a breakpoint you never reached tells you nothing about the state at it.
command: set -euo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; D="$(mktemp -d)"; cp ../scenarios/variable_state/*.py "$D/"; export PYTHONPATH="$D"; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/capture_breakpoints.py --break "$D/main.py:14" --local sentinel --out "$D/proof.json" -- "$D/main.py"
